role.zh: 基于PC的工业自动化与控制供应商
role.en: PC-based industrial automation and control supplier

overview.zh: 倍福于1980年成立，总部位于德国费尔。其产品覆盖工业PC、I/O与现场总线、驱动、自动化软件、无控制柜自动化及机器视觉，既可作为独立部件，也可组成控制系统。
overview.en: Founded in 1980 and headquartered in Verl, Germany, Beckhoff supplies industrial PCs, I/O and fieldbus hardware, drives, automation software, cabinet-free automation and machine vision, as components or integrated controls.

overview.zh: 技术路线以PC控制为中心，TwinCAT承载软件控制功能，EtherCAT提供实时以太网通信。机器人项目中的计算主机、I/O、运动轴和视觉接口仍需按具体任务搭配，不能把整个生态的能力赋给每一款工业PC。
overview.en: Its architecture centers on PC control, TwinCAT software and EtherCAT communications. A robot project still requires task-specific computing, I/O, motion and vision choices; ecosystem capability does not belong to every PC model.

overview.zh: C60xx包含Atom到Core处理器的不同配置；其他系列覆盖嵌入安装、控制柜、机架及工业服务器。官网还列出CAN FD、CANopen、PROFIBUS、EtherCAT等扩展卡与显示连接设备。
overview.en: C60xx spans Atom and Core configurations; other families cover built-in, cabinet, rack and server formats. The catalog also lists CAN FD, CANopen, PROFIBUS and EtherCAT cards and display links.

overview.zh: 官网披露2025年全球销售额为12.4亿欧元，同比增长6%。这是公司口径的全球销售披露，不是机器人业务收入，也不代替完整审计财报。
overview.en: The company reports 2025 global sales of EUR1.24 billion, up 6%. This is company-wide disclosure, not robotics revenue or a substitute for full audited financial statements.

customerGroups.zh: 机器设备与机器人制造商
生产线、物流及科研集成商

catalogScope.zh: 当前新增PC目录与其公开接口配件，不将所有可选配置展开为重复整机。
catalogScope.en: The new records cover PCs and linked interface accessories without expanding every option into duplicate systems.

investmentView.zh: 判断：跨行业控制平台的需求来源较广，但软件许可、项目维护与具体行业周期都会影响收入结构，不能由接口生态规模直接推算机器人业务规模。
investmentView.en: Assessment: cross-industry controls serve diverse demand, but licensing, maintenance and sector cycles shape revenue; interface ecosystem size does not establish robotics business size.

detail.zh: 公司官网记录1980年为成立年份。
detail.en: The company history records 1980 as its founding year.

overview.zh: C6025-0000是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6025-0000 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

integration.zh: 确认TwinCAT许可平台、操作系统、现场总线拓扑、接地和安装散热条件；带上市预告的选件不计作当前已交付配置。
integration.en: Confirm TwinCAT licensing level, OS, fieldbus topology, grounding and thermal installation. Announced options are not treated as currently delivered configurations.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6025-0020是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6025-0020 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。

integration.zh: 确认TwinCAT许可平台、操作系统、现场总线拓扑、接地和安装散热条件；带上市预告的选件不计作当前已交付配置。
integration.en: Confirm TwinCAT licensing level, OS, fieldbus topology, grounding and thermal installation. Announced options are not treated as currently delivered configurations.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6017-0040是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6017-0040 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

integration.zh: 确认TwinCAT许可平台、操作系统、现场总线拓扑、接地和安装散热条件；带上市预告的选件不计作当前已交付配置。
integration.en: Confirm TwinCAT licensing level, OS, fieldbus topology, grounding and thermal installation. Announced options are not treated as currently delivered configurations.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6017-0010是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6017-0010 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。

overview.zh: C6027-0010是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6027-0010 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

integration.zh: 确认TwinCAT许可平台、操作系统、现场总线拓扑、接地和安装散热条件；带上市预告的选件不计作当前已交付配置。
integration.en: Confirm TwinCAT licensing level, OS, fieldbus topology, grounding and thermal installation. Announced options are not treated as currently delivered configurations.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C7015-0030是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C7015-0030 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

integration.zh: 确认TwinCAT许可平台、操作系统、现场总线拓扑、接地和安装散热条件；带上市预告的选件不计作当前已交付配置。
integration.en: Confirm TwinCAT licensing level, OS, fieldbus topology, grounding and thermal installation. Announced options are not treated as currently delivered configurations.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6030-0070是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6030-0070 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6030-0060是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6030-0060 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

integration.zh: 确认TwinCAT许可平台、操作系统、现场总线拓扑、接地和安装散热条件；带上市预告的选件不计作当前已交付配置。
integration.en: Confirm TwinCAT licensing level, OS, fieldbus topology, grounding and thermal installation. Announced options are not treated as currently delivered configurations.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6032-0080是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6032-0080 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

integration.zh: 确认TwinCAT许可平台、操作系统、现场总线拓扑、接地和安装散热条件；带上市预告的选件不计作当前已交付配置。
integration.en: Confirm TwinCAT licensing level, OS, fieldbus topology, grounding and thermal installation. Announced options are not treated as currently delivered configurations.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6032-0070是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6032-0070 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。

overview.zh: C6032-0060是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6032-0060 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。

overview.zh: C6040-0090是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6040-0090 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。

overview.zh: C6043-0090是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6043-0090 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

integration.zh: 确认TwinCAT许可平台、操作系统、现场总线拓扑、接地和安装散热条件；带上市预告的选件不计作当前已交付配置。
integration.en: Confirm TwinCAT licensing level, OS, fieldbus topology, grounding and thermal installation. Announced options are not treated as currently delivered configurations.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6905-0030是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6905-0030 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

integration.zh: 确认TwinCAT许可平台、操作系统、现场总线拓扑、接地和安装散热条件；带上市预告的选件不计作当前已交付配置。
integration.en: Confirm TwinCAT licensing level, OS, fieldbus topology, grounding and thermal installation. Announced options are not treated as currently delivered configurations.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6905-0020是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6905-0020 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6920-0080是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6920-0080 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6920-0070是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6920-0070 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

overview.zh: C6920-0060是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6920-0060 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。

integration.zh: 确认TwinCAT许可平台、操作系统、现场总线拓扑、接地和安装散热条件；带上市预告的选件不计作当前已交付配置。
integration.en: Confirm TwinCAT licensing level, OS, fieldbus topology, grounding and thermal installation. Announced options are not treated as currently delivered configurations.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6930-0080是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6930-0080 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6930-0070是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6930-0070 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6930-0060是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6930-0060 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

overview.zh: C6925-0040是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6925-0040 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

overview.zh: C6515-0080是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6515-0080 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

overview.zh: C6515-0070是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6515-0070 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

integration.zh: 确认TwinCAT许可平台、操作系统、现场总线拓扑、接地和安装散热条件；带上市预告的选件不计作当前已交付配置。
integration.en: Confirm TwinCAT licensing level, OS, fieldbus topology, grounding and thermal installation. Announced options are not treated as currently delivered configurations.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6525-0080是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6525-0080 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

integration.zh: 确认TwinCAT许可平台、操作系统、现场总线拓扑、接地和安装散热条件；带上市预告的选件不计作当前已交付配置。
integration.en: Confirm TwinCAT licensing level, OS, fieldbus topology, grounding and thermal installation. Announced options are not treated as currently delivered configurations.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6525-0070是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6525-0070 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。

overview.zh: C6525-0060是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6525-0060 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。

overview.zh: C6640-0070是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6640-0070 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

overview.zh: C6640-0050是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6640-0050 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

applications.en: Industrial control, machine communication and automation integration

integration.zh: 确认TwinCAT许可平台、操作系统、现场总线拓扑、接地和安装散热条件；带上市预告的选件不计作当前已交付配置。
integration.en: Confirm TwinCAT licensing level, OS, fieldbus topology, grounding and thermal installation. Announced options are not treated as currently delivered configurations.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6650-0070是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6650-0070 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

overview.zh: C6650-0060是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6650-0060 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6650-0050是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6650-0050 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6675-0070是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6675-0070 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

overview.en: C6675-0060 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C6240-0080是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6240-0080 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

overview.zh: C6240-0070是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C6240-0070 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: C5210-0050是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C5210-0050 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

overview.zh: C5210-0040是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

overview.zh: C5210-0030是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C5210-0030 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

overview.zh: C5240-0030是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C5240-0030 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

overview.zh: C5240-0020是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C5240-0020 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

overview.zh: C5240-0010是倍福公开目录中的工业计算平台。记录按本型号技术列提取；CPU、内存、SSD和操作系统的必选项与选配项分开列出，不把所有配置的最大值拼成不存在的机器。
overview.en: C5240-0010 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial computing catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Mandatory and optional CPU, RAM, SSD and OS selections remain separate; their maxima are not combined into a nonexistent configuration.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

integration.zh: 确认TwinCAT许可平台、操作系统、现场总线拓扑、接地和安装散热条件；带上市预告的选件不计作当前已交付配置。
integration.en: Confirm TwinCAT licensing level, OS, fieldbus topology, grounding and thermal installation. Announced options are not treated as currently delivered configurations.

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: FC3101-0002是倍福公开目录中的工业接口或扩展设备。记录按本型号技术列提取；总线、电气、通道与连接方式见下方参数，不能继承相连主机的计算能力。
overview.en: FC3101-0002 is listed in Beckhoff's industrial interface/expansion catalog. Data is taken from its own technical column. Bus, electrical, channel and connection details are shown below; host computing performance is not inherited.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.

integration.zh: 确认TwinCAT许可平台、操作系统、现场总线拓扑、接地和安装散热条件；带上市预告的选件不计作当前已交付配置。

verification.zh: 判断：PC控制与模块化接口便于整合运动、视觉和设备通信，但实时性、驱动兼容和长期维护需要按最终配置验证。
verification.en: Assessment: PC control and modular interfaces support motion, vision and communications integration, but real-time behavior, drivers and lifecycle maintenance need configuration-level validation.

overview.zh: 控制系统需按实际I/O规模、周期、软件版本和环境条件验收。CPU核心数、接口连接数和总线理论速率不能单独证明某个机器人控制周期或端到端时延。
overview.en: Acceptance depends on I/O scale, cycle time, software version and environment. CPU core count, connector count and theoretical bus rate alone do not establish a robot-control cycle or end-to-end latency.
